title: Premise Recovery in Software Design: What Does This Decision Rest On?
abstract: arXiv:2611.21367v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Design decisions shape software architecture, and writing them down preserves the reasons behind it. Architecture decision records (ADRs) capture them, each with its context, choice, and consequences. A decision can depend on earlier ones: reversing one of them would force its review. We call these its premises. Yet ADRs do not always name their premises. When a decision is reversed, engineers supersede its ADR and search by hand for what it affects. That search can miss ADRs resting on an unnamed premise. We frame this as premise recovery: given an ADR with identifiers masked, find its premises among earlier records. We collect 1,060 ADRs from 36 repositories and label 1,529 candidate pairs for 60 target ADRs. Two LLM annotators agree at \k{appa} = 0.859. An independent human annotator, blind to their labels, agrees with the stated/implicit tag on 30 of 32 premises (\k{appa} = 0.875). We compare 7 open-weight models with 2 baselines t

translated_title: 软件设计中的前提恢复：这一决策建立在什么之上？
translated_abstract: 设计决策塑造软件架构，将它们记录下来可以保存决策背后的原因。架构决策记录（ADR）用于捕捉这些决策，每条记录包含其上下文、选择和后果。一个决策可能依赖于更早的决策：撤销其中一个将迫使依赖它的决策被重新审查。我们将这些被依赖的早期决策称为前提。然而，ADR 并不总是明确指出其前提。当某个决策被撤销时，工程师会废止其 ADR 并手动搜索其影响范围，这种搜索可能会遗漏基于未命名前提的 ADR。我们将其定义为前提恢复任务：给定一条标识符被遮蔽的 ADR，在更早的记录中找出它的前提。我们从 36 个代码仓库中收集了 1,060 条 ADR，并为 60 个目标 ADR 标注了 1,529 个候选配对。两个 LLM 标注者之间的一致性达到 κ = 0.859；一名独立的人类标注者在不知晓其标签的情况下，在 32 个前提中的 30 个上与明确/隐式标签一致（κ = 0.875）。我们比较了 7 个开放权重模型与 2 个基线……
tldr: 该论文提出“前提恢复”新任务，即在架构决策记录（ADR）未明确声明其依赖的先前决策时，自动从历史记录中识别出这些前提，并构建了首个包含 1,060 条 ADR 和 1,529 个标注配对的高质量基准数据集，用于评估大语言模型在该任务上的表现。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "premise recovery"—the task of automatically identifying the earlier decisions that an architecture decision record (ADR) silently rests on when they are not explicitly named—and contributes the first benchmark of 1,060 ADRs and 1,529 labeled pairs for evaluating large language models on this task.
